howPoints.title: How points work
howPoints.earnRate: Earn {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} per {amount} of your order subtotal.
howPoints.earnFallback: Earn points on the subtotal of every completed order.
howPoints.landing: Points land once the order is completed — orders still being prepared or on their way don’t count yet.
howPoints.checkout: At checkout, pick one reward from the list above — its points come off your balance and the discount comes off that order.
howPoints.redeemed: Redeemed points leave your balance right away and show in Recent activity. If that order is cancelled before it is completed, the points come back.
howPoints.climb: Keep ordering to climb tiers and unlock more perks.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.empty: No points activity yet — your first order will start earning.

rewards.empty: {brandName} hasn’t published any rewards yet. Your points keep adding up in the meantime — they don’t expire while you’re waiting.
rewards.pickAtCheckout: Pick one at checkout — one reward per order.

tiers.earnBody: You earn {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} for every {amount} of an order’s subtotal. Points are credited when the order is completed — nothing is added while an order is still pending, being prepared, or on its way, and cancelled orders never earn.
